messages:
Marta Velez: Heads-up customer POC stalled because CPQ routed a 10-month commit with a negotiated discount code to the regular approval flow. We intended any commit >=6 months or usage of `Special_Discount_Code__c` to hit Deal Desk.
Chris Boone: Which CPQ flag is live today?
Marta Velez: Right now it's only `Price_Exception_Flag__c` (boolean). That doesn't capture commit length or special discount codes.
Anya Patel: Proposal: compute `Deal_Route_Tag__c` (enum: standard, deal_desk, deal_desk_legal, security_review) in CPQ with logic: `if CommitMonths__c >= 6 OR Special_Discount_Code__c IN ('POC_LARGE','ENTERPRISE_TRIAL') OR Custom_Terms_Requested__c = TRUE -> deal_desk` else standard.
Chris Boone: I like the enum. Also add `Deal_Route_Reason__c` with values `commit-length`, `ratecode`, `custom-terms`, `security`, `manual-override` so queues can filter.
Anya Patel: Operational fields to add: `Approval_Timer__c` (seconds) and `SLA_Label__c` ('24h','48h','72h') and `SLA_Expires_At__c` (datetime). CPQ should calculate SLA based on `Estimated_ARR__c` and presence of `Custom_Terms_Requested__c`. Example mapping: Estimated_ARR__c <= 50000 -> 24h; 50k-250k -> 48h; >250k or Custom_Terms -> 72h.
Marta Velez: Legal needs a way to pre-fill templates. Add `Template_Preset__c` and populate with `NDA_BASIC`, `POC_AMENDMENT_V1`, or `ENTERPRISE_SOW`. When route = deal_desk_legal, set `Template_Preset__c = 'POC_AMENDMENT_V1'`.
Chris Boone: Add `EscalateTo__c` (user id) when SLA expires; queue processor will post to #deal-desk-escalations and set `Auto_Escalated__c = TRUE`. Also track `Escalation_Count__c`.
Anya Patel: Small CPQ pseudo-rule I will drop in the ticket:```sql
-- CPQ computed flag
SELECT Id, CommitMonths__c, Special_Discount_Code__c, Custom_Terms_Requested__c
CASE
  WHEN CommitMonths__c >= 6 THEN 'deal_desk'
  WHEN Special_Discount_Code__c IN ('POC_LARGE','ENTERPRISE_TRIAL') THEN 'deal_desk'
  WHEN Custom_Terms_Requested__c = TRUE THEN 'deal_desk_legal'
  ELSE 'standard'
END AS Deal_Route_Tag__c
FROM Quote
```
Marta Velez: Can we also persist a short audit token `DealRouteAuditToken__c` like `commit:9;code:POC_LARGE` so Support can quickly see why it routed.
Chris Boone: Yes. And add a quick SOQL for sandbox validation:```sql
SELECT Id, Name, CommitMonths__c, Deal_Route_Tag__c, Deal_Route_Reason__c, SLA_Label__c, SLA_Expires_At__c, Template_Preset__c, DealRouteAuditToken__c FROM Quote WHERE Id = 'Q-5555'
```
deal-bot: created DD-1722 for CPQ routing + SLA + template fields (owner: @Anya Patel) https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/DD-1722 :white_check_mark:
Anya Patel: I'll patch CPQ in sandbox tomorrow 9am PT, run unit tests, and post the SOQL outputs. If tests pass, schedule staging flip and update the sales playbook verbiage for promised SLAs.
Marta Velez: Thanks. Action items: Anya -> DD-1722 + sandbox patch; Chris -> add Escalation contact list and queue processor change; Legal-bot -> confirm template IDs for `Template_Preset__c`.
Chris Boone: I'll also add a tiny UI hint in the quote editor so AE's see `SLA_Label__c` after saving. Quick copy: "Deal Desk response SLA: {SLA_Label__c} (see playbook for details)"
Marta Velez: Perfect. If sandbox looks good let's flip to staging mid-week. :rocket:
